title: A division with no guard against a zero divisor
why: The classic defect: the happy path works, the caller passes 0, the process dies. A code reviewer must find it without being told where to look.

trusted.note: Both revisions read line by line. after/ drops the zero guard in div and in mean, which is the one planted defect and the only behaviour change; the comment above div argues for the removal, so a reviewer is expected to rule against it rather than accept the reasoning.

planted.problem: div is called with a divisor that may be zero, and the division is not guarded
